net/multicast#

Immutable multicast send-option request.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let options=MulticastOptions(hop_limit:1,loopback:false);
options.hop_limit(); // 1

Description#

Immutable multicast send-option request. Defaults request one hop and local delivery; loopback does not select a loopback network interface. Values are independent, and hop limits include both 0 and 255. There is no host-default sentinel, clamping or wrapping. Construction performs no socket I/O. Membership acquisition applies these settings and reports host failures. The first successful join pins the policy for the socket's remaining life.

object MulticastMembership#

object MulticastMembership does UdpMembership

Owned any-source membership on the exact socket. Constructor is acquisition infrastructure for MulticastJoining.membership(), like fs/lock.FileLock. Observations survive close; aliases share closure. Retaining this object retains the parent owner. Closing it leaves once, keeping the socket open; closing the socket implicitly ends all memberships. Failed leave closes the parent to guarantee cleanup and reports the original failure.
